basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old amateur photographer based in the Southeast of the UK. I recently picked up film photography as a hobby after inheriting an old SLR from my grandfather. I enjoy exploring the local countryside and urban areas, capturing the beauty in everyday moments. When I'm not snapping photos, I'm probably watching baseball or exploring scenic video games like Firewatch. I'm single and work as a graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule to indulge in my hobbies. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, especially after dinner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to film photography, most of my knowledge comes from online tutorials, YouTube videos, and community forums. I have a background in digital design, which helps me understand technical aspects of photography, but I'm still learning the nuances of film.
